title: Mid-weight content
slide_intent: Show how a short publication can alternate a strong cover message with accessible supporting information. The sequence should help someone move from interest to detail.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can adapt its identity to a focused leaflet, combining visible campaign language with enough space for photographs and explanation.
demonstration: Two tall leaflet views compare a boxed headline over the cover photograph with an interior page containing shorter text, a pullout, quotation and portrait. Type-role labels surround both views.
practical_value: Choose a compact hierarchy for a leaflet and separate the main message, supporting copy and attributed quotation before composing the pages.

content_islands.name: Publication brief
content_islands.spec: Use the left text column to identify the needs of a publication carrying a moderate amount of information.

content_islands.name: Cover and opening
content_islands.spec: Place the cover and interior examples side by side. Keep the strong cyan fields, photographic crops and contrasting headline boxes visible.

content_islands.name: Role annotations
content_islands.spec: Label each specimen outside its page boundary, using thin leaders for the logo, headline, subheads, body, pullout and image caption.
